title: Magadha Expansion
subject: History (CDS/NDA)

blocks.heading: 1. Dynasties
bullets: Haryanka Dynasty: Bimbisara (matrimonial alliances), Ajatashatru (patronised 1st Buddhist council).
Shishunaga Dynasty: Shifted capital to Vaishali, annexed Avanti.
Nanda Dynasty: Mahapadma Nanda (first empire builder, Ekarat), Dhana Nanda. Alexander the Great invaded India (326 BCE) during Dhana Nanda's reign, fought Battle of Hydaspes (Jhelum) with Porus.

formulas: Haryanka: Bimbisara | Nanda: Mahapadma Nanda | Hydaspes: 326 BCE (Alexander vs Porus)
